method: Rahil delegated the layout decision to Claude. Instead of a human stopwatch run, a fresh agent with no prior exposure ran the four spec §9.1 tasks in each layout through a real browser (screenshot-driven, randomised layout order per task) at 1440x900, plus tasks 1 and 4 at 390x844. Timings are looks/actions/ease, not ms. Full data: design/mockups/usability-results.json. Rahil can override by editing build[] before milestone 7.

confusion: Sidebar loads scrolled to round 9; Q2 not visible until scrolling the list up
Q2 shows 'Why A' rationale in red next to a free-text answer, which briefly reads as if A was chosen
Accept A does not advance to the next question; must click each list item then Accept
Accept button moves vertically per question (option count varies), so each one needs a fresh look
Visual hidden behind a small 'Visual · v3' header chip; not obvious it swaps the centre pane
Q15 region only marked by a tiny 'assumed · Q15 open' tag on a dashed box
Two text boxes (free-text answer vs 'Dig deeper' discussion); unclear which is 'pushback'
Reopened Q16 still shows option A with a green check, reading as settled
Agent's refinement (two files) collapsed behind '1 note' then 'more' (2 extra clicks to read in full)
ToC groups by topic: open Q15/Q19-21 listed under 'Transport', which is odd
'next' jumped first to reopened Q15 (round 8), not round 9
Round 9 isn't a group; its questions are scattered across topic sections and interleaved with reopened Q16, which had to be skipped by hand
Fast only with j/a keys; a mouse user would need a scroll and click per card
Hovering Q15 in the ToC gave no visible outline change
Visual thumbnail is small; needed a zoom to read the region label; outline only confirmed after clicking Q15 ('outlined above' caption)
Typed before focus landed (smooth scroll after ToC click): keystrokes fired j/k/a shortcuts and silently staged Q20 and Q21, with no warning
'Was:' struck-through text is identical to option A, which reads as a contradiction
Have to map Q2 to round 2 (round pills, not question ids)
Decision line truncated with an ellipsis; the agent refinement bubble fills in the rest
Narrow conversation column shows about one card at a time, so it's a scroll and look per question
No auto-advance after Accept
'7 open' badge doesn't change as items are staged; staged summary in the footer is truncated
Two paths ('Answer in words' on card vs '@q16 thread' composer); composer staged it as a thread message ('+1 msg'), not an answer, so it's unclear whether the agent treats it as a pushback answer
Question list is a short nested scroll strip (about 4 rows) above the card; scroll-in-scroll to find Q2, then scroll the page to see the answer
Nested list scroll again; free-text box and Stage below the fold
Visual card occupies the entire first screen before any content
No ToC on phone; only 'N open ↓' chip, which cycles Q15, Q19, Q20, Q21, then Q16 (5 taps)
Header, layout switcher and visual take the first screen; conversation starts below
Same thread-vs-answer ambiguity as desktop

notes: Build Studio: only layout where the visual is a first-class, hover-linked surface (task 3 at first glance, ease 5), best phone result, best desktop average. Brief skipped: its wins (instant decision lookup, phone reading) overlap Inbox/Studio, and its single-key shortcuts fired while focus was moving to a text field. Fixes to carry into the Studio build (T31) and core: after Accept/stage move to the next open question; open-count badges count down as you stage; one clear free-text path (answer-in-words vs thread) so pushback is unambiguous; shortcuts must never fire while a scroll-to-field is in flight (focus the field synchronously). Inbox: open list scrolled to show the current round but keep earlier rounds reachable; reopened questions should not look settled (no green check on the old answer).
